attributes.name: Phoenix Cloak
attributes.powers:
Recharge or display this card to reduce Fire damage dealt to you to 0.

If proficient with light armors, display this card to add 3d4 and the Fire trait to a combat check by a character at your location.

If you would die, display this card.

While displayed, if you would die, bury this card to shuffle 10 random cards from your discard pile into your deck and reset your hand. You are no longer dead.
